name: Git
description: The repository's status as a document, lazygit's panels in magit's form: changed files with their diffs under them (Tab), staged by file, hunk or line with magit's keys, committed, pushed and pulled; branches and stashes; changed lines marked beside the lines; on Doom's SPC g keys, with the arrows, Enter and Escape

programs.git.description: Where git is, when it is not the one on the PATH: a full path; empty for the PATH's

status_placement.description: Where the status opens: in the current pane (Escape returns), or in a pane beside it

context_lines.description: Lines of context around each change of a diff

untracked.description: Untracked files in the status: folders collapsed, every file, or none

pull.description: How Pull pulls: as git's pull.rebase says, by rebasing, by merging, or only by fast-forwarding

fetch_prune.description: Fetch removes the remote branches that are gone from the remote

log_graph.description: The log draws its branches' graph at the left

log_count.description: Commits a log loads at a time

remote_link.description: What a link to the remote names: the branch, or the commit

gutter.description: Marks in the gutter on the lines changed since the base

gutter_base.description: What the gutter marks compare with: the staged version, or the last commit

confirm_discard.description: Reverting a file or a hunk asks first

glyphs.description: Fold marks and arrows as ▸ ▾ ↑ ↓, or as > v ^ v for a terminal font without them
